subject: round-6 criticality count consistency (18 markers / 17 starred rows / 31 substantive rows / the reported "x4")

verdict.summary: The workbook formula does not multiply by 4 (the "x4" was an unpersisted chat paraphrase of the four basis-kind COUNTIF terms). Independently, the dashboard formula B28 is wrong for two of three cases, and marker_lost_count is blind to markers that were discovered but attributed to no atom.

B28.label: 实质性要求数（源依据）
B28.formula: =COUNTIF('03_资格否决与强制项'!$J$2:$J$999,"SUBSTANTIVE_STARRED")+COUNTIF('03_资格否决与强制项'!$J$2:$J$999,"SUBSTANTIVE_EXPLICIT_WORDING")+COUNTIF('03_资格否决与强制项'!$J$2:$J$999,"SUBSTANTIVE_VIA_REFERENCE*")+COUNTIF('03_资格否决与强制项'!$J$2:$J$999,"SUBSTANTIVE_BY_LAW*")
B28.reason: J cells hold '；'-joined multi-type strings (e.g. 'SUBSTANTIVE_STARRED；REJECTION'). The first two COUNTIF patterns carry no '*' wildcard, so they match nothing; only 'SUBSTANTIVE_VIA_REFERENCE*' matches (7 rows).

D1.what: 实质性要求数（源依据） lacks the '*' wildcard on the SUBSTANTIVE_STARRED and SUBSTANTIVE_EXPLICIT_WORDING terms, so it evaluates to 7 (CASE001) and 3 (CASE003) instead of 31 and 4.
D1.why_the_gates_missed_it: scripts/v1_review_workbook_round6_report.py check_dashboard only asserts the labels exist and that a token appears in the formula text; scripts/v1_review_workbook_visual_qa.py dashboard_formulas_evaluate only compares the 7 manual-review counters and never evaluates the criticality counts.

D2.where: marker_lost_count in all three round-6 audits
D2.what: audit_markers iterates atoms with marker_present=True, so markers discovered by discover_marker_evidence but never attributed to an atom are invisible: CASE001 2 markers, CASE002 6 markers owned by the delivered row DR028 (★ cell empty) plus 10 with no atom, CASE003 0.
D2.consequence: marker_lost_count=0 and 'every source-marked row shows ★' (CASE002: 1 marked row) are not established for CASE001/CASE002 as stated.

D3.what: the formula was paraphrased as COUNTIF(03!J:J,"SUBSTANTIVE_*")x4; no committed artifact contains that text.
D3.explanation: C - the four basis-kind COUNTIF terms were described as 'x4' and got confused with the formula text.
